title: AiAP : AI Agents for Professional Excellence
details:
No-code AI agent building and automation strategy programme · Institute: myAi · 18 August 2026 to 27 November 2026. Six live sessions and two workshops. Faculty: Mohammad Saif Noman Khan (IBA, University of Dhaka) and Mark Anupom Mollick (iDEAN Consulting). Programme credential: myAi Certified AI Automation Strategist.

myAiVisit website ↗

What the course covered

  • Agent anatomy: what makes an agent different from a chatbot, and the five parts every agent needs: brain, instructions, memory, tools and guardrails.
  • The Automation Map: list every weekly task, sort it by frequency and judgment, split it into steps, then pick which steps to hand over. You automate a step, not a job.
  • Automation strategy: the Task Decision Matrix (eliminate, automate, augment or keep human), the five levels of automation, and four stop signs. Any task that touches confidential data, moves money, reaches a customer or cannot be undone stays under human approval.
  • The AI toolbox: assistant platforms, always-on agents, workflow builders such as n8n and Zapier, and self-hosted agents, with what each one is good for.
  • Building with AI: saved skills, small AI apps and a personal website, each built live.
  • Workshops: 2 October 2026, Build Your AI Agent Army: a 25-agent plan for one company, five departments by five agents, then building the top-priority agent. Closing workshop: 27 November 2026.

What I built

  • A standing agent workspace: one profile every agent reads first, one rule book, and four files per agent: charter, protocol, format and log.
  • RMG Xpress Morning Briefing: my first agent, built 1 September 2026. It reads Bangladesh RMG and global apparel news across nine beats and returns a ranked brief with a risk radar, an opportunity radar and three actions for the day.
  • Merchandising tools: the tools on my Projects page, built in Claude Cowork and now used by colleagues in my office.

The rule I kept

  • Every agent proposes and I approve. None of them sends, deletes or invents a number.

title: AiPS : AI for Professional Success
details:
AI capacity-building program · Institute: myAi · 19 May 2026 to 17 July 2026. Structured AI study run alongside the day job, covering prompt engineering, productivity, career acceleration, fundamentals, leadership, and business applications.

myAiVisit website ↗

What I kept

  • Prompt engineering, applied: the daily workflow now runs on structured prompts, correspondence with Poland HQ and vendors, weekly reporting, vendor data consolidation, and presentation prep.
  • The limit I set: AI drafts, I decide. Nothing goes out under my name that I have not checked.
